opening.argument: The presentation is structured as an educational walkthrough of three PancakeSwap methods: regular staking of CAKE, supplying CAKE and BNB to a liquidity market, and staking the resulting LP tokens in an LP farm. The speaker expressly limits the context by stating, “now this is not financial advice just for educational purposes,” while the on-screen list reinforces the instructional sequence. Although passive income and APR are discussed, the material provides no guaranteed return, identifies no particular recipient, promises no transaction outcome, and directs viewers to no specific destination. Those features support an instructional explanation of staking and liquidity operations rather than a solicitation built on a promised result.

citations.quote: now this is not financial advice just for educational purposes
So you have regular staking, add liquidity to the market and then you actually stake your LP tokens that you get for adding liquidity
